# DescriptionList

A set of values, each under its label, with no field chrome (GAP-221, decision 199): a record's read-only view. MAP-619 opens a unit for a Read-Only user as its values, not as a form, because greyed, outlined fields read as disabled inputs. Each value is a muted 12/16 label over the value, 14/20 in the foreground, 4 apart, and items are 16 apart; a value can be words, tags, a yes or a no, or carry an action after it such as Copy.

- **Import:** `import { DescriptionList, DescriptionListItem } from "@kozmos-ds/react";`
- **Group:** Core
- **Platforms:** React, SwiftUI and Compose; linked to its Figma component through Code Connect.
- **Storybook:** <https://vodoco.github.io/kozmos-design-system/storybook/?path=/docs/data-display-descriptionlist--docs>

## Example

From its `Default` story.

```tsx
import {
  Badge,
  DescriptionList,
  DescriptionListItem,
  ThemeProvider,
} from "@kozmos-ds/react";

export function DescriptionListExample() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">
      <div style={{ maxWidth: 480 }}>
        <DescriptionList aria-label="Unit">
          <DescriptionListItem label="Name" value="Bean & Leaf Café" />
          <DescriptionListItem label="Categories">
            <Badge variant="secondary">Café</Badge>
            <Badge variant="secondary">Food</Badge>
          </DescriptionListItem>
          <DescriptionListItem label="Featured" value={true} />
          <DescriptionListItem label="Hidden from visitors" value={false} />
        </DescriptionList>
      </div>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## DescriptionList

A set of values each under its label, with no field chrome (GAP-221,
decision 199): a record's read-only view, such as MAP-619's unit for a
Read-Only user. A `<dl>`, each `DescriptionListItem` a `<dt>` and its
`<dd>`, so a screen reader hears each label with its value. Not MetaStrip,
which draws a few facts as tiles in a strip that scrolls sideways.

It forwards its ref to `HTMLDListElement`. Its props are `DescriptionListProps`, which extends `React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDListElement>`.

- `layout`: `DescriptionListLayout`, optional, default `"stack"`.

  `"stack"` (the default) or `"row"`.

- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## DescriptionListItem

One label and its value (GAP-221): the label 12/16 in the muted
foreground over the value 14/20 in the foreground, 4 apart, with no
border, fill or field around them.

It forwards its ref to `HTMLDivElement`. Its props are `DescriptionListItemProps`, which extends `Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "children">`.

- `label`: `React.ReactNode`, **required**.

  The label, over the value: its `<dt>`.

- `value`: `React.ReactNode | boolean`, optional.

  The value: words, tags (Badges or Chips) or any other part. `true` and
  `false` are a yes or a no, written as `yesLabel` and `noLabel`.
  `children` is the value too, where `value` is not given.

- `children`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.
- `action`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.

  A part after the value, on its line, such as an `IconButton` that
  copies it. It is part of the `<dd>`, read after the value.

- `yesLabel`: `string`, optional, default `"Yes"`.

  The words for a `true` value: "Yes" by default.

- `noLabel`: `string`, optional, default `"No"`.

  The words for a `false` value: "No" by default.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## Types these props take

### DescriptionListLayout

From `@kozmos-ds/react`.

```ts
/**
 * How a DescriptionList's items go (GAP-221, decision 199): `"stack"`, one
 * under another; `"row"`, side by side, as many to a line as fit, each at
 * least 10rem wide, wrapping onto the next.
 */
type DescriptionListLayout = "stack" | "row";
```
